title: ModuleTaskServerService
responsibility: Validate module-task plans against committed module contracts, preserve each module responsibility as the task goal, and dispatch only matching assignments through workers without accepting submissions.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root used by the task repository, commit-tree reader, registry and worker.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.constructor.dependencies
inputs.type: Partial<{ repository: ModuleTaskRepository; openTree: typeof CommitTreeAdapter.open; registry: Pick<UnitRegistryRepository, 'read'>; requireMetadata: typeof requireModuleData; worker: Pick<ModuleTaskWorkerService, 'once'>; }>
inputs.description: Optional in-process collaborators for queue persistence, exact-commit reads, unit registry admission, metadata checks and worker dispatch.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.submit.input
inputs.description: A non-null, non-array object with a feature parsed by featureSchema and a tasks array whose items are parsed by taskInputSchema. Duplicate task IDs and task-feature ID mismatches are rejected. Extra root keys and an empty tasks array are not rejected here. Nested unknown-key behavior is delegated to schemas whose dependency contract does not publish strictness.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.run.input
inputs.description: The same plan passed to submit; run submits it before worker dispatch.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.run.execution
inputs.type: { worker: string; modules: string[]; once: boolean; signal: AbortSignal }
inputs.description: Worker and module IDs must match the unit-ID pattern, module IDs must be unique, once must be boolean, and signal must be AbortSignal-shaped. A signal already aborted at validation rejects before submit.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.submitApproved.input
inputs.description: Select the exact latest approved plan; trusted guard rechecks source, metadata, images and graph.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.constructor.dependencies.plans
inputs.description: Defaults to the real feature plan guard; test collaborators may be injected.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.runApproved.execution
inputs.description: Worker id, integer concurrency from one to eight and cancellation signal; validated before submission.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.submit
outputs.type: Promise<{ created: string[]; reused: string[]; commit: string | undefined }>
outputs.description: Returns created and reused task ID arrays from the queue merge and the repository update commit, which may be undefined. Equivalent queued definitions are reused; conflicting feature or task definitions reject. It does not return feature or task objects. The service prepares all records and calls repository.update once with the selected tree revision after plan, module and metadata checks; the repository dependency contract does not specify compare-and-swap semantics. It validates each task against the selected-commit module contract with root responsibility included and sets the admitted task moduleGoal to that exact non-empty responsibility; the task-specific wantedContract remains unchanged.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.run
outputs.type: Promise<{ submission: { created: string[]; reused: string[]; commit: string | undefined }; results: unknown[] }>
outputs.description: When once is true, resolves with the submit result nested under submission and a results array containing the one result from exactly one awaited worker.once call. When once is false, calls worker.once repeatedly and retains at most 100 results internally, but never resolves with them: cancellation rejects with AbortError after the active call settles. The service awaits worker.once directly, so cancellation does not interrupt a worker call that does not settle. Watch mode treats result.status === 'idle' as a reason to poll again after 50 ms; the worker.once dependency contract declares its result as unknown. Once mode does not loop to drain matching work, and the service does not recheck cancellation after submit or after a successful once call.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.submitApproved
outputs.description: Admits only tasks from the verified approved plan and checks the identical complete plan within the queue compare-and-swap before merging. Preserves dependency IDs and returns idempotent reused tasks.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskServerService.runApproved
outputs.description: Verify the approved plan and its readiness, prepare and atomically merge exact task definitions, recheck approval, then concurrently dispatch only its admitted scope with bounded workers. Wait for every started claim before returning or rejecting.

errors.name: Invalid plan
errors.description: A non-object plan or missing tasks array throws Error. featureSchema and taskInputSchema parse failures propagate as ZodError; duplicate task IDs and feature ID mismatches throw Error.

errors.name: Module admission failure
errors.description: Service-generated admission and task-preparation failures are Error; feature/task schema failures are ZodError; commit-tree open may throw Error or ExpectedCliError; required-metadata failures are Error. The UnitRegistryRepository dependency contract leaves source-tree listing/read failures unknown, and this service propagates them. Invalid registry manifests, an unregistered or inactive module, unsafe or empty owned source scope, a missing module goal for derived responsibility, an invalid task-shaped contract, or task preparation failure throw before repository.update.

errors.name: Conflicting queued definition or repository failure
errors.description: Conflicting feature or task definitions throw before mergePlan mutates the queue draft; repository read/update failures propagate.

errors.name: Invalid run execution
errors.description: Invalid worker ID, module filter, duplicate module ID, once value or signal shape throws before submit.

errors.name: Run cancellation
errors.description: An already-aborted signal rejects before submit. Watch mode rejects with an AbortError named 'AbortError' and message 'Module task run aborted' after an active worker call settles and cancellation ends the loop. In once mode the signal is passed to worker.once; cancellation normalization is delegated to that worker call.

errors.name: Worker failure
errors.description: Once-mode worker rejection propagates. In watch mode a worker rejection propagates unchanged unless the signal is aborted, in which case it is converted to the run AbortError.

errors.name: stale or changed approved plan
errors.description: Reject before queue mutation when the verified approval or current queued plan differs, disappears, is invalid or changes during admission.

errors.name: Invalid or changed approved dispatch
errors.description: Invalid execution, stale approval or readiness fails before worker dispatch; worker failures propagate after every started worker settles.
